attacks.name: Solar Energy Beam
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Synthezoid Avenger
steps: The defender does not add |!critical| results in its defense roll to its total successes and cannot add additional dice to their defense roll as a result of |!critical| results.

superPowers.name: Calculated Trajectory
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of Size 3 or less and within |!range| 2, and throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Rapid Phase
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an enemy attack, this character may use this superpower. Remove the current |<phasing_double>Phasing Type| then choose a new Phasing type.

superPowers.name: Phasing
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character chooses a |<phasing_double>Phasing| type:|\||*Enhanced Density|: This character rolls 3 additional dice when defending against |!physical| attacks and cannot be pushed until the start of the next |*Power Phase|.|\||*Phased|: This character rolls 3 additional dice when defending against |!energy| attacks and does not suffer collision damage until the start of the next |*Power Phase|.
